title: minuartia confusa
intro: Minuartia confusa, commonly known as the confused or common mouse-ear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Minuartia confusa include analgesic, anti-rheumatic, and anti-hypertensive effects, which can provide relief from pain, reduce inflammation, and lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
